variables.meaning: total pressure that stays constant along the flow
variables.name: pt
variables.quote: We call this constant the total pressure pt of the flow.

variables.meaning: static pressure from random molecular motion
variables.name: ps
variables.quote: The equation states that the static pressure ps in the flow plus the dynamic pressure

variables.meaning: fluid density that stays constant in low speed flow
variables.name: rho
variables.quote: one half of the density rho (ρ) times the velocity V squared

variables.name: v
variables.quote: times the velocity V squared, is equal to a constant throughout the flow.
